rationale: The round 4 exchange has clarified the economics but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour/state insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/investors still condition any settlement on materially stronger structural savings and keep closures on the table. Positions are hardened, but the process is stuck in repeating demands for plant-by-plant proof without any movement toward a bridge that either side would accept, so a mediator-style intervention is needed rather than more of the same.
